stem.text: A voltage is carefully measured with a high-quality instrument and found to be $2.321\,\text{V}$.
Two students, using two different methods, conclude that the voltage is $2.33\,\text{V}$ and $2.344\,\text{V}$ respectively.

A.text: $2.33\,\text{V}$ is less accurate and less precise than $2.344\,\text{V}$.

B.text: $2.33\,\text{V}$ is less accurate and more precise than $2.344\,\text{V}$.

C.text: $2.33\,\text{V}$ is more accurate and less precise than $2.344\,\text{V}$.

D.text: $2.33\,\text{V}$ is more accurate and more precise than $2.344\,\text{V}$.
